description:
*Objective:* Verify that when only one copy exists, the first add succeeds and a second add is rejected.

*Type:* negative  
*Level:* end-to-end  
*Priority:* high

*Preconditions:*
* Application is reachable (local disposable environment)
* A regular user account is available
* Books are located by title via catalog search, never by ID, because IDs change when the database is reseeded
* An admin account is available
* No single-copy book exists in the seeded catalog, so the case creates its own as admin
* A unique title is built from the current date and time (the QA title)

*Test data:*
* New book: QA title, author "QA Author", price 20.00, stock 1
* Quantity per add: 1

*Steps & Expected results:*
# Open the login page and sign in with the admin account  
   *Expected:* User lands on the catalog page; the Logout button and the Admin button are visible
# Open the Admin dashboard and the Books tab  
   *Expected:* The "Add New Book" form is visible
# Fill title (QA title), author "QA Author", price 20.00, stock 1 and click Add Book  
   *Expected:* The book list shows a card with the QA title, $20.00 and "Stock: 1"
# Click Logout  
   *Expected:* Session ends; the Login button is visible
# Open the login page and sign in with the regular user account  
   *Expected:* User lands on the catalog page; the Logout button is visible
# Open the cart; remove every line that is present  
   *Expected:* Cart is empty; the cart badge in the navigation is absent or 0
# On the catalog page type "[QA title]" into the search box and click Search  
   *Expected:* A catalog card titled "[QA title]" is listed
# Open the detail page of "[QA title]"  
   *Expected:* Detail page opens with heading "[QA title]" and price $20.00
# With Quantity 1 click Add to Cart  
   *Expected:* Cart badge shows 1
# Click Add to Cart again  
   *Expected:* A visible error states there is not enough stock; cart badge still shows 1
# Open the cart  
   *Expected:* One line for the QA book, quantity 1, subtotal $20.00

*Postconditions:*
* Cart holds one copy of the QA book
* The QA book is deleted by an admin afterwards

*Traceability:*
* User story: REF-10
title: Reject adding a second copy of a single-stock book
